subject.title: Feature: TTS delivery mode option — separate text + voice messages on Telegram

question: Should OpenClaw add a public Telegram TTS delivery policy for separate text-plus-voice delivery, and should it live under global `messages.tts` or Telegram/channel-specific config?
rationale: The source-level problem is real, but adding a config selector is a product/API contract choice that overlaps related captioned-final and voice-only TTS directions.

options.title: Approve a narrow delivery policy
options.body: Define a backward-compatible delivery mode with docs and tests for captioned/bundled versus separate behavior before implementation.

options.title: Standardize captioned delivery
options.body: Keep captioned delivery as the supported behavior and document tagged/manual splitting plus overflow fallback instead.

options.title: Defer until captioned-final settles
options.body: Wait for the related captioned-final PR direction before choosing this config shape.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow delivery policy
recommendation.body: Define a backward-compatible delivery mode with docs and tests for captioned/bundled versus separate behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history spans TTS config, TTS core, and Telegram caption delivery, with this owner signal strongest across those surfaces.
